correct.title: Correct invoice record
correct.readOnlyNotice: This screen does not edit the invoice: the customer, lines and amounts do not change. It only re-submits the invoice record with the same data already saved, leaving a record of the reason. If the invoice content is wrong, a corrective invoice applies; if the transaction never happened, it should be cancelled instead.
